:new: New project intention · #26 Submanifolds and regular value theorem

The regular value theorem, a foundational result in differential geometry

  • submersions: basic definitions and API (e.g., submersions are automatically smooth)
  • equivalent characterisation of submersions (in terms of differential), invariance under composition
  • regular values and the regular value theorem
  • potential applications: the unit sphere is a smooth manifold, SL(n) is a smooth manifold

This builds on previous work (e.g. defining immersions, the regular value theorem, defining immersed/embedded submanifolds). All of this is developed in mathlib-level generality and aims for mathlib inclusion.
